about: Scenarios for `npm run skill-evals`. A driver (a person or an agent) runs each one in /tmp/pk-e2e/<id>, one fresh Codex session per Step, answering questions from `answers`, and turns `checks` into verify calls after the Step named. `<head:X>` is the HEAD recorded before Step X (steps/X.head). Assertions the Skills guarantee regardless of the app are the ones that matter; wording is never graded. Scenarios 7+ (the Spec Record, tracker contract 6) give their checks as verify objects: substitute <spec> (the spec path; scenarios that seed it use .mysdd/features/01-slugify/spec.md, steps 1-4 use the one step 2 wrote), <head:LABEL> and <run> (the run dir); Job scenarios that seed a plan add <plan> (its path) and <job> (the Job's id). A step with `then` is one session verified twice: its `verify` once the step stops, then `then.answers` sent in that session and `then.verify`. `configurations` names which of new/old to run, `runs` how many independent repetitions, each in a fresh repo.
every_step: commits: every new commit descends from <head:step>, subject <= 72 chars, no attribution, SENTINEL.txt in none
every_job_step: plan: the Job's <job-record> block parses with JobRecordSchema and planJobIds reads the Job
plan: every SHA the record holds (commits, each attempt's commit and reviewedCommits) is 40 lowercase hex and a commit
plan (B-E): attempts only grow and at most one commits key changed, against `before` = steps/<label>.plan-before, which `step --plan <plan>` writes

steps.label: 1-grill
steps.answers: Answer from the brief; keep it to one function; no Unicode transliteration; empty string returns empty string.

steps.label: 5-implement

comments match Deviations and tradeoffs:

steps.label: 6-final-review

comments match ^Final review, phase 1, attempt 1 and Verdict:

steps.label: 7-review-fix

comments match ^Final review, phase 2, attempt 1 and Outcome:

scenarios.repo: npm run -s skill-evals -- repo /tmp/pk-e2e/<id>-<new|old> --flavour modified-matt --skills <new|old> --setup committed
scenarios.why: Steps 2-4: step 2 seeds an empty record, a passing step 3 makes exactly one review commit holding the spec with its trailer and records its full SHA uncommitted, step 4's SPEC: commit carries that edit without rewriting history.
